note: Contract STRAP inputs of the compute die: constants by contract (identity / configuration), tied by the die. Every other constant on an input is a defect the port-bind reports (INPUT_TIED), e.g. chain-terminus ready ties and the lockstep tile's tap_r (requests to the DVM builder: variants without those inputs). qfd_sp_band_lanes.tt is the RTL-contract strap-gated input of bands 1/2 (b0 = 0: the band ignores it; only band 0 receives the tree-top word). Q-B2 10-16 (b2 per-side port remap): qfd_port_half_b2.hb is the captured physical halfband identity (0..5); qfd_sp_halfband_lanes_b2_l2.b0 selects the single native tree-return half (HB0), its tt_l0..tt_l7 upper returns are the strap-gated inputs of halves 1..5 (b0 = 0 ignores them, exactly as qfd_sp_band_lanes.tt), and lnk is the per-half relay strap set ONLY from the calibrated phase manifest (the production writer refuses emission while it is OPEN).
